tier_should.rationale: Develops Olson-Zeckhauser framework for pharma pricing; provides new evidence that GDP predicts above-proportional contributions, challenging full free-riding. Solid but limited identification and simple cross-country regressions constrain novelty. Strong fit for health economics field journals.

tier_will.rationale: High-credibility authors and NBER visibility increase odds. Likely to place in strong health economics outlet; top-field possible but uncertain given modest empirical strategy and policy-essay flavor.
